input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

This scene:
一个人问神农，哪个植物好吃。神农说，这就要看你的口味了。要是你喜欢吃甜的，有很多甜的水果，比方说苹果、西瓜和梨。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有好处。神农说，有很多种植物对你的身体有好处，比方说小白菜、黄瓜、茶和菠菜。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有坏处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一个别的人问神农：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 一个别的人问神农：第三个人

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use the measure word “种” when asking which kind of plant is meant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 这就要看你的口味了：这就要看你喜欢吃什么了，In the pattern “这就要看……了,” the part after “看” should be an embedded question, such as a wh-question.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，“别的” distinguishes other people from a stated person or group; use “另一个人” to introduce the next individual in the scene.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use the measure word “种” when asking which kind of plant is meant.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，“别的” distinguishes other people from a stated person or group; use “另一个人” to introduce the next individual in the scene.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use the measure word “种” when asking which kind of plant is meant.

items.reason: “哪个植物” is acceptable Chinese here, although “哪种植物” is also a good alternative.
“这就要看你的口味了” is already a correct use of the fixed “这就要看……了” structure.
“一个别的人” misuses 别的; “另一个人” correctly introduces another person.
“哪个植物” is not an error, even though “哪种植物” is more specific.
“一个别的人” is incorrect because 别的 does not mean an additional individual; “另一个人” is grammatical here.
The original “哪个植物” is acceptable; the correction is optional rather than required.
